 Virat Kohli eyes Sachin Tendulkar, Ricky Ponting's records in New Zealand ODI series
 Virat Kohli is closing in on Sachin Tendulkar and Ricky Ponting's records against New Zealand in international cricket and ODIs. He will look to continue his impressive form in the upcoming five-match series, starting November 4.
 Advertisement Virat Kohli is chasing quite a few records on the New Zealand tour. Courtesy: AP By: India Today Sports Desk New Delhi , Nov 3, 2026 21:43 IST Last Updated Nov 3, 2026 21:43 IST Published by sabyasachi chowdhury Nov 3, 2026 21:43 IST Written By Sabyasachi Chowdhury Virat Kohli will have two major batting milestones in sight when India take on New Zealand in a five-match ODI series, starting November 4. The former India captain is closing in on Sachin Tendulkar’s record for the most international runs against the Black Caps across formats and Ricky Ponting’s long-standing mark in ODIs.
 Kohli has scored 3,167 international runs in 60 matches against New Zealand, including 10 centuries and 16 half-centuries. He is 178 runs short of Tendulkar, who tops the list with 3,345 runs in 66 matches. England's Joe Root occupies second place with 3,268 runs from 56 matches, while Ponting and Jacques Kallis complete the top five. advertisement ❮ ❯ Read Full Story Most international runs against New Zealand
 Sachin Tendulkar (India): 3,345 runs in 66 matches
 Joe Root (England): 3,268 runs in 56 matches
 Virat Kohli (India): 3,167 runs in 60 matches
 Ricky Ponting (Australia): 3,145 runs in 69 matches
 Jacques Kallis (South Africa): 3,071 runs in 67 matches
 The 37-year-old has another significant milestone within reach in the 50-over format. Kohli has accumulated 1,897 runs in 36 ODIs against New Zealand at an impressive average of 57.48, with seven centuries and 10 half-centuries. He needs 74 runs to surpass Ponting, who leads the ODI run-scoring charts against the Kiwis with 1,971 runs in 51 matches.
 Also Read: Rohit, Virat take centre stage as India switch to ODI World Cup prep in New Zealand 
 Kohli is also 103 runs away from becoming the first batter to score 2,000 ODI runs against New Zealand. Tendulkar is third on the list with 1,750 runs in 42 matches, followed by Sri Lanka's Kumar Sangakkara and Sanath Jayasuriya.
 Most ODI runs against New Zealand
 Ricky Ponting (Australia): 1,971 runs in 51 matches
 Virat Kohli (India): 1,897 runs in 36 matches
 Sachin Tendulkar (India): 1,750 runs in 42 matches
 Kumar Sangakkara (Sri Lanka): 1,568 runs in 47 matches
 Sanath Jayasuriya (Sri Lanka): 1,519 runs in 47 matches
 KOHLI’S RICH VEIN OF FORM
 Kohli will head into the series with plenty of confidence, having enjoyed an excellent run of form in 2026. He has scored 552 runs in nine ODI innings this year at an average of 69, registering two centuries and three half-centuries. His highest score came against the West Indies, when he smashed an unbeaten 139 off just 88 balls in Thiruvananthapuram in September.
 He followed it up with scores of 29 and zero in the remaining two matches of the series, finishing with 168 runs across three games. Earlier in the year, Kohli had also made a significant contribution against New Zealand, scoring 93, 23 and 124 in India's three-match home series. His 124 in the third ODI in Indore helped underline his continued appetite for big scores against the Kiwis.
 The upcoming series will also give Kohli an opportunity to strengthen his record in New Zealand. He has scored 596 runs in 13 ODIs in the country at an average of 49.66, including one century and four half-centuries. He will be keen to add to that tally while helping India prepare for the 2027 ODI World Cup. - Ends
